blurb: Barry’s Seattle is the first PNW location, situated in the heart of South Lake Union. Our studio at 112 Westlake Ave N offers the world-class HIIT and Strength workout designed to "burn off the Seattle freeze." Featuring a fully stocked Fuel Bar, free guest Wi-Fi, and luxury locker rooms, we are the go-to fitness hub for the SLU tech community and Downtown Seattle.
